description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'ModuleServiceTest' for testing the 'ModuleService' class within the 'OrangeHRM' Human Resource Management system. It includes setup methods and unit tests for 'getModuleDao', 'getModuleList', and 'updateModuleStatus' functions, utilizing mocks and fixtures.

classes.name: ModuleServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the ModuleService functionalities, including fetching and updating module data.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the ModuleService instance before each test.

methods.name: testGetModuleDao
methods.description: Tests that getModuleDao returns an instance of ModuleDao.

methods.name: testGetModuleList
methods.description: Tests that getModuleList returns expected list of modules, verifying the service interacts correctly with the DAO.

methods.name: testUpdateModuleStatus
methods.description: Tests that updateModuleStatus updates and returns the correct list of modules based on input array.
